name: Young Optics Inc.
summary: Young Optics Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacturing, and sale of optical components, engines, systems, parts, modules, and instruments in Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally.
